MAYOR’S FUND SUBCOMMITTEE MINUTES

James Howat, Member  Leanna Noble, Member
Julie Lie, Member  Stephen Wood, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Jim Howat, calls the meeting to order at 3:11 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Howat, Lie, Noble

  Commissioners Absent: Wood

Also present: Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

Roll call taken by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-57295  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Mayor’s Fund Subcommittee
  meeting of Monday, November 10, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Noble, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Howat, Lie, Noble, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Wood

2.  25-57296  Recommendation to receive and file the Mayor’s Fund Balance Update from the
  Health Department.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Noble, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4 Howat, Lie, Noble, Scott

  Page 1 of 3

  No:  0  None

  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Wood

  • Staff and subcommittee members discussed the available balance of the
  Mayor’s Fund. Last week, three agencies were reimbursed; His Little Feet
  and the Disabled Resources Center have now been fully reimbursed and
  closed out.
  • Chair Howat raised questions regarding the utility bill inserts and the
  production process. He would like to have a Repographics staff member
  present to discuss the utility bill insert process.

3.  25-57297  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the Mayor’s Fund Utility bill
  inserts and fundraising 2026 strategies for the Mayor’s Fund.

  A motion was made by Member Noble, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Howat, Lie, Noble, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Wood

  • Staff will work on bringing forward the utility bill insert process later in the
  year. Subcommittee members expressed interest in ensuring that the inserts
  are reaching all Long Beach residents.
  • Staff and subcommittee members discussed three fundraising options to
  focus on in the upcoming year.

4.  25-57298  Recommendation to discuss and approve future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Noble, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Howat, Lie, Noble, Scott
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Wood
